Response variable.reasoning: This header names the dependent variable or trait being measured in the model.

Model.reasoning: This column contains statistical model identifiers, not biological data.

Explanatory variable.reasoning: This header names the independent variables or predictors being measured.

Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the calculated coefficient or value of the measurement.

Std.Error.reasoning: This column provides the standard error, a statistical measure of the estimate.

lower CI.reasoning: This column provides the lower bound of the confidence interval, a statistical measure.

upper CI.reasoning: This column provides the upper bound of the confidence interval, a statistical measure.

z-value.reasoning: This column provides the z-score, a statistical measure of the estimate.

P.reasoning: This column provides the p-value, a statistical measure of significance.
